questions.question: In 2018, Bharat Vatwani and _________ were the two Indians awarded with the Ramon Magsaysay award.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. Sonam Wangchuk.

__
 
• **Bharat Vatwani** and **Sonam Wangchuk**__ were among the winners of the **Ramon Magsaysay Award 2018.**
 
• Bharat Vatwani is a psychiatrist who works for mentally-ill people living on the streets.
 
• The Ramon Magsaysay Award is often referred to as the Asian version of the Nobel Prize.
 
• Sonam Wangchuk, a mechanical engineer/scientist has revolutionized the teaching methods in the hilly areas of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladhak.
 
• His speciality includes coming up with low-cost solutions to modern-day problems with minimal resources but the highest efficiency.
 
• A character named "Phunsukh Wangdu" in the film " 3 Idiots" is inspired by him.
 
• __Wangchuk __builds Ice Stupas to facilitate irrigation in the desert areas of the western Himalayas.
 
• In 1988, he founded SECMOL (Students’ Educational and Cultural Movement of Ladakh).
 
• This school especially teaches only those students who have failed in their exams and not even those who score fewer marks.
 
• 
 
Ramon Magsaysay Award was awarded to him in the year 2018. (considered the Nobel Prize in the East)

questions.question: In May 2019, Pakistan successfully test-fired a surface-to-surface ballistic missile named ________.

questions.question: In Economics, buying an asset in one market and simultaneously selling an identical asset in another market at a higher price is termed as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Arbitrage.

__
 
• The process of **Arbitrage**__ refers to the simultaneous buying and selling of an asset from different platforms, exchanges or locations to cash in on the price difference.
 
• In this case, only the price difference is captured as the net pay-off from the trade.
 
• The pay-off should be large enough to cover the costs involved in executing the trades.

questions.question: _______________ is the first Indian gymnast to win a Gold medal at a Global Event in the World Challenge Cup in Turkey.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Dipa Karmakar.

__
 
• **Dipa Karmakar**__ is the first Indian gymnast to win a Gold medal at a Global Event in the World Challenge Cup in Turkey.
 
• She is from Agartala, Tripura.
 
• She has been coached by veteran Bisbeshwar Nandi.
 
• Since 2007, she has won 77 medals including 67 gold, in-state, national and international championships.
 
• She won a bronze medal at the 2014 Commonwealth Games and at the Artistic Gymnastics Asian Championships in Hiroshima, Japan.

questions.question: The historical Sher Shah Suri Marg is called as:

questions.question: Jawaharlal Nehru port is located in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Maharashtra.

__
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru Port is located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**__.
 
• It is the first port in the country to implement logistics data tagging of containers.
 
• The port implemented the logistics data tagging of containers which will help importers and exporters track their goods in transit.
 
• An RFID (Radio Frequency Identification Tag) tag would be attached to each container and tracked through RFID readers installed at different locations.

questions.question: _________ is a large mass of snow and ice at an high altitude that slides down mountain slopes.

questions.question: What is the chemical name of slaked lime?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Calcium Hydroxide.

 
• Slaked lime is the other name of Calcium hydroxide.
 
• Chemical formula: Ca(OH)2
 
• It is widely used for mortar, plaster, and cement in buildings.
 
• It is also used in wastewater treatment.

questions.question: After going through the processes of scouring and bleaching, 99% of cotton is made up of which polymer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. Cellulose.

__
 
• Cellulose is mainly found in plants and therefore is the main constituent of woods which makes it the most abundant organic compound on earth.
 
• It is the main constituent of plant fiber; plants contain on average 33% cellulose, and **cotton is the purest form at 90%**__.
 
• Cellulose is a linear polymer of as many as 10,000 D-glucose units. 
 
• Cellulose from wood and cotton is used in the manufacturing of paper, cardboard, cellophane, and rayon.

questions.question: With which of the following sports is the term 'tumble turns' associated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3, i.e. Swimming.

__
 
• In **swimming,**__ a tumble turn or flip turn is one of the turns. 
 
• At the time of swimming, it is used to reverse the direction.
 
• It is done when the swimmer reaches at the end of the swimming pool but has one more turn left to complete swiftly.
